verdict.rationale: Claude offers a developer API (claude-docs-2), so versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. The only related items are a community report that Opus 4.6 removed assistant-message prefill, which now returns a 400 error, and a release-notes link in llms.txt. Neither establishes a versioned API or a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
